title: Can’t ask for better app than this!!
body:
So aesthetic, fun, and genuinely makes life super productive. This app turns habit tracking into something you actually look forward to. The design is beautiful, the experience feels smooth, and it keeps you consistent without any pressure.

It’s one of those rare apps that blends style and productivity perfectly. Truly irreplaceable 💯

title: I like the app but has some rough edges
body: For example - Dynamic Island / live activity should not be shown anymore when the timer is paused (allow have to dismiss manually every time, especially annoying for weekly / monthly time trackers). Also, why is Dynamic Island widget so large? It blocks the clock and battery status. Take a page from Timery app how to implement activities and widgets well.

title: Seemed good at first
body: This app seemed very clear and good at first sight. I managed to add 4 habits on my list, and mark one done. But now that I’m trying to add one more habit on my list, I’m just offered to uppgrade to the premium version, and there’s nothing else I can do ☹️I was under the impression that I could use the basic features for free, but it seems I was wrong. I guess this is a good app for those willing to pay. I’m not, at least not after only trying the app for a couple of hours!
